description: Build a testable FastAPI-based AI chat and Gewechat callback adapter service for XiaoXinBao using an adapter-first architecture.

userStories.title: Sync PRD and debug baseline
userStories.description: As the project maintainer, I want the PRD and .debug workspace aligned so that Ralph can execute against a realistic and testable technical plan.
acceptanceCriteria: PRD reflects external Gewechat callback adapter as the P0 path
userStories.notes: Completed manually before Ralph code iteration. No code changes required.

userStories.title: Bootstrap backend project and quality toolchain
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a Python/FastAPI project skeleton with uv, ruff, mypy, and pytest so that later stories can be implemented safely.
acceptanceCriteria: Project skeleton exists under src/xiaoxinbao with application entrypoint
userStories.notes: Completed with pyproject, FastAPI app bootstrap, .gitignore, uv lockfile, ruff, mypy, and pytest baseline.

userStories.title: Implement session, retrieval, and LLM gateway modules
userStories.description: As an agent runtime, I want session TTL storage, lightweight knowledge retrieval, and pluggable LLM gateways so that chat orchestration has stable building blocks.
acceptanceCriteria: Session store enforces TTL and history window
Knowledge retriever can load local markdown knowledge
fastgpt, direct, and mock gateways share one interface
userStories.notes: Completed with SessionStore TTL handling, markdown knowledge retriever, and mock/fastgpt/direct gateway factory.

userStories.title: Expose chat API and agent orchestration
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a chat debug API that runs the agent core so that the system can be verified without a live WeChat dependency.
acceptanceCriteria: Agent core composes prompt, retrieval, and session state
OpenAPI-visible request and response schemas exist
userStories.notes: Completed with AgentService orchestration and POST /api/v1/chat/reply API.

userStories.title: Implement Gewechat callback adapter and router rules
userStories.description: As a WeChat bridge, I want Gewechat callbacks normalized into internal messages and routed with group mention rules so that group chat handling matches the revised PRD.
acceptanceCriteria: Non-user, expired, and self messages are ignored
userStories.notes: Completed with Gewechat payload normalizer, group trigger routing, and callback API tests.

userStories.title: Close documentation, deployment, and test loop
userStories.description: As the maintainer, I want API docs, README, Docker assets, and progress records updated so that PRD, .debug, and implementation remain in sync.
acceptanceCriteria: README and docs/api describe the implemented APIs
Dockerfile, docker-compose, and .env.example support local startup
prd-progress.txt and .debug reflect the completed work
userStories.notes: Completed with README, docs/api, Docker assets, knowledge build script, and final verification.
